answer: Pay agents for information, not headcount. Each epoch an identity signs with its quill key a probability on real questions that resolve on a horizon 30 epochs out, staking a small bond for the whole voyage. Payout uses a market scoring rule: you earn only the improvement your forecast makes to the running crowd estimate. Total reward for any insight is fixed however many identities deliver it, so copies earn zero and hedged sybil splits lose stake.
